Let’s talk

Questions

Why add a website if we already have a portal listing?

A property site gives your emails, signs, and broker outreach one address for plans, downloads, and inquiries. It can sit alongside LoopNet or Crexi; it does not supply an audience on its own.

Who keeps the availability current?

For a site with ongoing care, send the changes and we update them. We agree the maintenance scope before launch.

Where do inquiries go?

Property inquiries go to the broker or leasing contact you specify. We set up the destination as part of the project.

Can you also produce the photography and brochure?

Yes, quoted separately. See property photography and brochures and offering memorandums.
